name: GIRDER 格拉德 Fame 2025 Ultegra Di2
why_interesting: The Ultegra Di2 build of the 2025 T47/UDH aero frame family at an official ¥21,800 and a 7.9 kg claim; distinct from the older press-fit Ultegra R8020 FAME.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra Di2 R8170 2×12; FC-R8100 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R8100 11-34T cassette, CN-M8100 chain
facts.frame: 2025 FAME T800 + T1000 carbon aero frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, UDH dropout, fully hidden routing, separate Shimano battery storage
facts.frame_material: T800 + T1000 carbon frame (reinforced bottom-bracket area) and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded aero frame and fork with fully hidden routing
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found; the reinforced bottom-bracket wording is manufacturer construction copy, not a test result
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 threaded, P1.0 thread, 84.5 mm shell width supplied with two 1 mm shims (the frame line separately says 'BSA'; the BB row is the more specific value)
facts.wheels: Adler Augen unpainted Classic carbon wavy-rim wheels, 60 mm, ceramic-bearing hubs, Sapim spokes
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×28C folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: Adler Augen 2025 unpainted aero integrated handlebar, internal routing, 6° offset
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 497/371, S 506/380, M 517/385, L 529/393.6; head angle 70–72°, seat angle 74.5–75°, chainstay 410 mm, BB drop 72 mm, wheelbase 977–993 mm. These values are identical to the NEW 2025 ARROW chart.
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
